attributes.additional_details: We must have a General Election now — because the current administration is selling this country down the river. Our communities are neglected, living standards are falling, and public trust is broken. Decisions are being made that shape our future. This Government no longer reflects our values or our hopes. It is time to let the British people choose. To restore accountability, to set a better course, and to give this nation back to those who built it — we need an election.
attributes.background: It is time to call a General Election. The current party is selling our country down the river — putting our future, prosperity, and values at risk. The British people deserve better, and they deserve their say. Let the public decide who will truly serve and protect this nation.

rejection.details:
